name: Kresnik ~Saiin ni Modaeru Kyuuketsuki Hunter~
original_name: クルースニク～催淫に悶える吸血鬼ハンター～
source:
A vampire hunter was bitten by a vampire, and the antidote that she had drunk to save her from becoming a full vampire made her horny like an aphrodisiac. The trouble in handling this problem fell into the hands of our protagonist -- her brother...

[Edited from a synopsis by fhc]
translation:
一名吸血鬼猎人遭到吸血鬼咬伤。她为了避免彻底变成吸血鬼而服下解药，药物却像媚药一样令她欲火焚身。处理这个麻烦的责任落到了主人公——也就是她的哥哥——手中。

[编辑自fhc的简介]
